reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering peppers, fertilizer, desserts, ice resources and fish, combat rings, iridium resources, sprinklers, and iron were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover fertilizer percentages, ring effects, sprinkler coverage, established fish and material names, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

HotPepper_Description.source: Fiery hot with a hint of sweetness.
HotPepper_Description.translation: Foarte iute, cu o ușoară notă dulce.

HyperSpeedGro_Name.preservationReason: Hyper Speed-Gro is the canonical in-world brand spelling required by the approved Romanian glossary.

HyperSpeedGro_Description.source: Greatly stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 33%. Mix into tilled soil.
HyperSpeedGro_Description.translation: Stimulează considerabil producția de frunze. Garantează accelerarea creșterii cu cel puțin 33%. Amestecă-l în solul afânat.

IceCream_Description.source: It's hard to find someone who doesn't like this.
IceCream_Description.translation: Este greu să găsești pe cineva căruia să nu-i placă.

IcePip_Description.source: A rare fish that thrives in extremely cold conditions.
IcePip_Description.translation: Un pește rar care prosperă în condiții de frig extrem.

ImmunityBand_Description.source: The top of the ring is made from enchanted purple wool.
ImmunityBand_Description.translation: Partea superioară a inelului este făcută din lână violetă vrăjită.

IridiumBand_Description.source: Glows, attracts items, and increases attack damage by 10%.
IridiumBand_Description.translation: Strălucește, atrage obiecte și mărește daunele de atac cu 10%.

IridiumOre_Description.source: An exotic ore with many curious properties. Can be smelted into bars.
IridiumOre_Description.translation: Un minereu exotic cu multe proprietăți neobișnuite. Poate fi topit în lingouri.

IridiumSprinkler_Description.source: Waters the 24 adjacent tiles every morning.
IridiumSprinkler_Description.translation: Udă cele 24 de dale adiacente în fiecare dimineață.

IridiumStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain iridium ore.
IridiumStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține minereu de iridiu.
